description: This file defines utility functions related to parsing and applying verbose level overrides within session entries. It handles raw inputs, validates, normalizes, and updates session configurations for verbosity levels.

methods.name: export function parseVerboseOverride( parseVerboseOverride
methods.description: Parses and validates a raw value to produce a VerboseLevel or an error message.

methods.name: export function applyVerboseOverride(entry: SessionEntry, level: VerboseLevel | null | undefined/ applyVerboseOverride
methods.description: Updates a session entry's verbose level based on the provided level, handling null and undefined cases.

ctags.name: applyVerboseOverride
ctags.pattern: /^export function applyVerboseOverride(entry: SessionEntry, level: VerboseLevel | null | undefined/
